LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Build a Fleet—Rule the Sea!

Key Features:
• Over 800 historical ships recreated in breathtaking, true-to-life detail.
• Five different ship types—submarines, destroyers, cruisers, battleships, and aircraft carriers—all offering distinct gameplay challenges.
• Tech Tree with 13 distinct nations and dozens of branches to explore.
• Epic multiplayer naval battles between massive fleets across a multitude of gigantic maps.
• Deep customization options ranging from Commander skills and ship modules to camouflages and enemy destruction effects.
• Constant updates and new content, including ships, commemorative flags, special game modes, and combat missions to earn valuable in-game rewards.
• Free to download and has a progression system that you can advance through simply by playing the game and accumulating experience.

Website: https://worldofwarships.com/
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@WorldofWarshipsOfficialChannel
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/WorldOfWarships/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/worldofwarships/
